classification.A: non_anomalous, spotlight, coherent CPHD+SICD, useful ocean ROI, temporal hard gate, favorable geometry, complete measured directional spectrum within limits
classification.B: passes physical/metadata hard gates but has model-only screening reference
classification.C: retained control for duration, weak sea state, geometry, land control, or 5-7 s comparison
classification.D: one or more explicit hard gates fail
classification.E: required metadata/reference are unavailable and a hard gate cannot be evaluated
classification.abstention_policy: if no A passes, report no primary; do not tune thresholds post hoc
classification.missing_data_policy: never impute a measured peak period or pass an unverifiable hard gate

wave_model.period_proxy_policy: model mean may screen only; never rename as peak period
